exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: How often do you go out with friends? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Tell me about your best friend at school.

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: How friendly are you with your neighbours? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Which is more important to you, friends or family? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a writer you would like to meet. You should say: who the writer is what you know about this writer already what you would like to find out about him/her and explain why you would like to meet this writer.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of book are most popular with children in your country? Why do you think that is?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do you think some children do not read books very often?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: How do you think children can be encouraged to read more?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Are there any occasions when reading at speed is a useful skill to have? What are they?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Are there any jobs where people need to read a lot? What are they?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you think that reading novels is more interesting than reading factual books? Why is that?
